steps.title: Daily dashboard overview
steps.narration: The home screen shows today's stock leaderboard at a glance — every ranked name with its composite score, regime signal, and key setup flags already computed.
steps.point_out: The ranked stock table with scores and the current market regime indicator at the top of the page.

steps.title: Stock leaderboard with filters
steps.narration: The Stocks page lets you slice the leaderboard by sector, pattern, or score tier so the highest-conviction names rise to the top instantly.
steps.point_out: The filter controls along the top of the leaderboard and the ranked rows updating beneath them.

steps.title: Stock detail with explainable scores
steps.narration: Clicking into any stock opens its detail page — score breakdown, detected patterns, price and moving-average chart, and a forward-test scorecard all on one screen.
steps.point_out: The score component bars that explain exactly why this stock ranks where it does, and the price chart extending to the current as-of date.

steps.title: Theme leaderboard
steps.narration: The Themes page ranks every tracked theme by the same composite scoring engine, so you can see which narratives have the most momentum behind them right now.
steps.point_out: Theme rows ranked by score, each summarising the constituent stocks driving the theme's position.

steps.title: Backtest forward-test evidence
steps.narration: The Backtest page shows how a scanner run from any past date actually performed: a forward-test scorecard with realized returns, attribution by score tier, and a leadership cohort breakdown.
steps.point_out: The forward-test scorecard table with realized return percentages and the attribution section below it.

steps.title: Factor Lab — decile analysis
steps.narration: The Research page is the analytical engine: pick any factor, and the lab instantly shows decile-sorted rank-IC, risk-adjusted returns, and regime-conditioned effectiveness across all historical snapshots.
steps.point_out: The decile chart and rank-IC table that show how strongly this factor predicts forward returns.

steps.title: Data Manager — coverage and unfinished imports
steps.narration: The Data Manager gives you full visibility into what data is loaded: a per-symbol coverage table, any unfinished imports that can be retried or dismissed, and controls to fetch new history or remove user-added bars.
steps.point_out: The per-symbol coverage table listing bar counts and date ranges, and the Unfinished Imports panel with retry and dismiss actions.

steps.title: Methodology and glossary
steps.narration: Every score, pattern, and term in the product has a plain-language explanation on the Methodology page — no black boxes, just rules you can read and reason about.
steps.point_out: The glossary entries and scoring-rule descriptions that explain exactly how each setup and rank is computed.
